fields.title: Get money back for an order

sections.What it does: The money goes back to the card that paid, and reaches at most what [svc-payment-api](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c48af9fd8a47a887efc5d40a3db13a6b4e31e7b1/examples/payments/services/payment-api.md) captured.
sections.Who it is for: Customers who have returned an order. Every one of them paid through [ofr-card-payment](https://github.com/paul80nd/knowledge-as-code/blob/c48af9fd8a47a887efc5d40a3db13a6b4e31e7b1/examples/payments/offerings/card-payment.md), so this group is part of that one.
sections.Why it exists: The card schemes require a route to a refund. A customer who doubts they can get the money back does not pay.
sections.Known limitations: A card that has expired since the payment cannot be refunded to it.
